description: Create a payment request: a checkout pre-addressed to ONE named client — their name and email pre-filled, a fixed tax-inclusive amount due, an optional due date. For invoicing-shaped selling (a tradie's deck deposit, a consultant's milestone, an accountant's fixed fee). Set send_email true to email it to the client immediately (from the merchant via GoCushy, replies to the merchant's inbox) — usually what the merchant means by 'send Dave an invoice'; otherwise return the signed url for them to paste into their own email/SMS. Reminders default ON around the due date (3 days before, on the day, a week after — three at most, stopping the moment it's paid); pass reminders false to switch them off for this request. Pass either product_id (an existing one-time product at its own price) OR description + amount_cents for a one-off amount; one-off products never appear in the catalogue. For NZ sellers who collect GST the amount is treated as GST-INCLUSIVE and split to the cent at creation (a stated overseas client_country zero-rates it); the client gets the standard sequentially numbered tax invoice when they pay. allow_bank_transfer adds the merchant's bank details to the page AND the email so the client can pay from their banking app (needs bank details in seller defaults or passed here, and a paying plan — a 422 names whichever is missing); the merchant then records receipt with record_payment_request_payment. A 422 payment_requests_disabled means the feature is not enabled on this environment — relay that, don't retry.

allow_bank_transfer.description: Show the merchant's bank details on the page (paying plans; needs saved bank details)

amount_cents.description: Total due in minor units, tax-INCLUSIVE (required without product_id)

client_country.description: ISO country, for GST treatment — an overseas client zero-rates an NZ seller's request. Omitted: derived from the client's last paid order, so a repeat overseas client zero-rates automatically

client_email.description: Where the request, receipt and tax invoice go — also the key for deriving a repeat client's name, country and prefilled checkout

client_name.description: The client's name, as the invoice should identify them. Optional for a repeat client — derived from their last paid order (or prior request) with this merchant; a 422 says when there is no history to derive from

currency.description: Defaults to the seller's default currency

description.description: The line the client and the invoice read, e.g. 'Deck build — milestone 1' (required without product_id)

due_at.description: ISO due date. Informational + reminder anchor — the page stays payable past it; late is still paid

note.description: Free text shown on the page and under the amount

product_id.description: An existing one-time product to request at its own price

reminders.description: Due-date reminder emails (default true; capped at three, stop on payment)

send_email.description: Email the request to the client now — the merchant's usual intent when they say 'send an invoice'

name: create_payment_request
title: Send a payment request
